title: Venetian shutter-blinds 3D slat flip
blurb: Two live HTML views inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas, sliced into 4 to 24 pivoting 3D slats across horizontal, vertical and diagonal louver axes. Scrubbing or flipping turns each slat through 180 degrees in perspective with staggered phase delay, cosine shading, rim highlights and an unmirrored swap at 90 degrees.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas slice two live drawable HTML views into 4 to 24 pivoting 3D Venetian slats across horizontal, vertical and diagonal axes, swapping front and back faces unmirrored at 90° with cosine shading and dark louver gaps while keeping controls interactive at 0% and 100%?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass on one ElementGL context (1.02 MP, 8.18 MB), staggered 50% wave shows Sheet B on slat 0 and Sheet A on slat 5 with a dark gap between, cosine shading dims turning slats while keeping Sheet B unmirrored, and updateElementGeometry() routes live clicks and input edits at 0% and 100%. Chrome 159 on Android and check:jank stay not verified.
